title: Step 4: Decide Win, Lose, or Draw

blocks.content: Step 4: Decide Win, Lose, or Draw
Now let's create a method to decide whether the user won, lost or drew. This method will:

items: take two arguments (the user input and computer's pick)
"draw" if the computer's pick and the user's pick are the same
"win" if the user wins using the rules we described earlier
"lose" if none of the conditions for draw or win are met

blocks.content: Notice that we are using the equals() method to compare the string variable with the strings directly.
Next, we will combine all three methods in our code and see if it works.
